 Ritz brings its crunch to gluten-free
 The company is aiming to make a big move into inclusive snacking, it says.
 By SF&WB Staff 
 Courtesy of Ritz 
 October 19, 2026 
 Mondelēz International's Ritz brand is releasing Ritz Gluten Free Crackers in Original Flavor, the first-ever gluten-free product from the 90+-year-old-brand. The snack will arrive on shelves this month at Walmart and Albertsons, with nationwide expansion in February 2027.
 According to the company, its gluten-free patrons have been asking for Ritz by name for years, and it has finally come up with the right recipe. The brand says the crackers offer the same golden-baked, buttery, flaky experience consumers already know from the Ritz brand.
 This launch reflects Mondelēz International's broader commitment to meeting consumers where they are—expanding its brands into new formats and dietary options (i.e. Oreo Thins and Zero Sugar, Ca! Gluten Free & Clif High Protein) so more people can enjoy the snacks they grew up with, without sacrificing taste.
 Each 8-oz package will retail for $4.49, and the crackers do not include artificial colors or flavors.
 Mondelēz International is on the current Snack Food & Wholesale Bakery “Top 50 Snack & Bakery Companies” list.  Click here  to view the current “Top 50” rankings.
 KEYWORDS: Gluten-free crackers Mondelez International Ritz
